verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for HR/payroll software, since open-source HR platforms exist, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only help-center payroll, benefits, time-off, onboarding and Xero docs, plus probes that returned 404. Nothing shows a public source repository or an open license.
